Rork  why you not finish  this task ? FINAL IVX CAPITAL PLATFORM COMPLETION — EXECUTE, VERIFY, DEPLOY
NO NARRATIVE. NO PARTIAL COMPLETION. NO PLACEHOLDERS.

The Executive Layer audit has identified the remaining production gaps.

Complete every remaining item end to end, verify with production evidence, then deploy.

==================================================
PHASE 1 — INVESTOR LIFECYCLE
==================================================

Complete the full investor lifecycle:

Prospect
→ Qualified
→ KYC
→ AML
→ Accredited Verification
→ Opportunity Matched
→ Soft Commitment
→ Subscription Documents
→ Signed
→ Wire Pending
→ Wire Received
→ Escrow
→ Capital Deployed
→ Active Investment
→ ROI Tracking
→ Distribution
→ Reinvestment
→ Closed

Every stage must be stored in production and reflected in the Executive Layer.

==================================================
PHASE 2 — CAPITAL PIPELINE
==================================================

Complete:

• Investor Commitments
• Soft Commitments
• Signed Commitments
• Wire Tracking
• Escrow Tracking
• Capital Received
• Capital Pending
• Capital Deployed
• Funding Goals
• Funding Percentage
• Investor Statements
• Capital Ledger
• Transaction History

Every dollar displayed must trace to production records.

==================================================
PHASE 3 — DEAL FUNDING
==================================================

For every active deal:

• ONE STOP CONSTRUCTORS
• Casa Rosario
• Perez Residence

Implement:

• Investors Assigned
• Capital Required
• Capital Committed
• Capital Received
• Funding %
• Escrow Balance
• Closing Status
• ROI Projection
• Investor Allocation
• Document Package
• Audit Trail

No deal may display funding information without production evidence.

==================================================
PHASE 4 — CRM AUTOMATION
==================================================

Complete:

• Meetings
• Follow-ups
• Tasks
• Notes
• Calls
• Emails
• Investor Timeline
• Relationship History
• Automatic Reminders
• Owner Notifications

All activities must synchronize across Web, Android, and iOS.

==================================================
PHASE 5 — FINANCIAL LEDGER
==================================================

Implement:

• Revenue Ledger
• Expense Ledger
• Cash on Hand
• Monthly Burn
• Cash Flow
• Operating Expenses
• Investor Transactions
• Distribution Ledger
• Profit Ledger
• Bank Reconciliation

If insufficient verified data exists, display "No Verified Data" instead of estimates.

==================================================
PHASE 6 — AUTONOMOUS EXECUTION
==================================================

Every autonomous action must have:

• Task ID
• Job ID
• Worker ID
• Logs
• Start Time
• End Time
• Duration
• Files Changed
• Commit SHA
• Deployment ID
• QA Results
• Production Verification

Remove any counters that cannot be backed by real execution records.

==================================================
PHASE 7 — EXECUTIVE LAYER
==================================================

Verify every KPI against production.

No KPI may use:

• Mock Data
• Seed Data
• Demo Data
• Placeholder Values
• Hardcoded Values
• Static Arrays

Every value must be reproducible from the database.

==================================================
PHASE 8 — END-TO-END QA
==================================================

Execute full regression on:

• Owner Login
• Investor Portal
• Buyer Portal
• CRM
• Capital Pipeline
• Executive Layer
• Autonomous Dashboard
• IVX IA Chat
• Mobile
• Web
• APIs
• Database
• Authentication
• Notifications
• Reports

Fix every failed test before deployment.

==================================================
PHASE 9 — PRODUCTION DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

After every test passes:

• Commit changes
• Push to GitHub
• Deploy Render
• Deploy Web
• Build Android (EAS/APK if applicable)
• Verify production health
• Verify live APIs
• Verify database migrations
• Verify Executive Layer
• Verify Capital Pipeline
• Verify IVX IA Chat
• Verify Autonomous Dashboard

==================================================
PHASE 10 — REQUIRED PROOF
==================================================

Return only verified evidence:

✓ GitHub Repository
✓ Branch
✓ Commit SHA
✓ Render Deployment ID
✓ Production URL
✓ /health HTTP 200
✓ Database Migration Results
✓ QA Report
✓ Regression Report
✓ Executive Layer Screenshots
✓ Capital Pipeline Screenshots
✓ Investor Lifecycle Screenshots
✓ Autonomous Dashboard Screenshots
✓ Android Verification
✓ Web Verification
✓ API Test Results
✓ SQL Validation
✓ Production Timestamps

==================================================
FINAL ACCEPTANCE
==================================================

Do NOT mark COMPLETE until all of the following are true:

✓ Investor lifecycle is fully operational.
✓ Capital pipeline is production-backed.
✓ Deal funding is connected to investors.
✓ Financial ledger is complete.
✓ CRM automation is operational.
✓ Executive Layer uses only verified production data.
✓ Autonomous actions are backed by real execution records.
✓ End-to-end QA passes.
✓ Production deployment is complete.
✓ Live verification succeeds.
✓ Every claim is supported by logs, records, and evidence.

Only then mark:

STATUS: VERIFIED
STATUS: DEPLOYED
STATUS: PRODUCTION READY
